title: VPN Connection Troubleshooting
content: Check your internet connection. Restart the VPN client. Verify your username and password. Clear the VPN cache. Restart your computer. Check firewall and network configuration.

title: Password Reset Guide
content: Open the company password portal. Click on Forgot Password. Verify your identity. Create a new password. Confirm the new password. Try logging in again.

title: Email Not Working
content: Check your internet connection. Check mailbox storage. Restart Outlook. Remove and re-add the email account. Verify email server settings.

title: Printer Not Printing
content: Check whether the printer is powered on. Verify the printer connection. Check the paper and ink. Clear pending print jobs. Restart the printer and computer.

title: Slow Computer Troubleshooting
content: Restart the computer. Close unnecessary applications. Check CPU and memory usage. Remove temporary files. Scan the computer for malware. Update system software.
